v_student_attendance_report.definition:
SELECT s.student_id,
    s.admission_no,
    (((u.first_name)::text || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(u.last_name, ''::character varying))::text) AS student_name,
    c.class_name,
    sec.section_name,
    count(*) AS total_periods,
    sum(
        CASE
            WHEN ((sa.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Present'::character varying, 'Late'::character varying])::text[])) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END) AS attended,
    round(((100.0 * (sum(
        CASE
            WHEN ((sa.status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['Present'::character varying, 'Late'::character varying])::text[])) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END))::numeric) / (count(*))::numeric), 2) AS attendance_pct
   FROM ((((student_attendance sa
     JOIN students s ON ((s.student_id = sa.student_id)))
     JOIN users u ON ((u.user_id = s.user_id)))
     JOIN sections sec ON ((sec.section_id = s.section_id)))
     JOIN classes c ON ((c.class_id = sec.class_id)))
  GROUP BY s.student_id, s.admission_no, u.first_name, u.last_name, c.class_name, sec.section_name;

v_exam_report.definition:
SELECT e.exam_name,
    (((u.first_name)::text || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(u.last_name, ''::character varying))::text) AS student_name,
    sub.subject_name,
    es.max_marks,
    m.marks_obtained,
        CASE
            WHEN (m.marks_obtained >= es.pass_marks) THEN 'Pass'::text
            ELSE 'Fail'::text
        END AS result,
    g.grade
   FROM ((((((marks m
     JOIN exam_schedules es ON ((es.exam_schedule_id = m.exam_schedule_id)))
     JOIN exams e ON ((e.exam_id = es.exam_id)))
     JOIN subjects sub ON ((sub.subject_id = es.subject_id)))
     JOIN students s ON ((s.student_id = m.student_id)))
     JOIN users u ON ((u.user_id = s.user_id)))
     LEFT JOIN grade_scale g ON ((g.grade_id = m.grade_id)));

v_pending_leaves.definition:
SELECT lr.leave_id,
    (((u.first_name)::text || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(u.last_name, ''::character varying))::text) AS applicant,
    r.role_name,
    lt.type_name,
    lr.from_date,
    lr.to_date,
    lr.reason
   FROM (((leave_requests lr
     JOIN users u ON ((u.user_id = lr.applicant_id)))
     JOIN roles r ON ((r.role_id = u.role_id)))
     JOIN leave_types lt ON ((lt.leave_type_id = lr.leave_type_id)))
  WHERE ((lr.status)::text = 'Pending'::text);

v_timetable.definition:
SELECT sec.section_id,
    (((c.class_name)::text || '-'::text) || (sec.section_name)::text) AS section,
    t.day_of_week,
    p.period_no,
    p.start_time,
    p.end_time,
    sub.subject_name,
    (((u.first_name)::text || ' '::text) || (COALESCE(u.last_name, ''::character varying))::text) AS faculty_name,
    cr.room_name
   FROM (((((((timetable t
     JOIN sections sec ON ((sec.section_id = t.section_id)))
     JOIN classes c ON ((c.class_id = sec.class_id)))
     JOIN periods p ON ((p.period_id = t.period_id)))
     JOIN subjects sub ON ((sub.subject_id = t.subject_id)))
     JOIN faculty f ON ((f.faculty_id = t.faculty_id)))
     JOIN users u ON ((u.user_id = f.user_id)))
     JOIN classrooms cr ON ((cr.classroom_id = t.classroom_id)));
